nonBlockingObservations.location: SCOPE.md, statement that all new items are macOS-only; work_ledger.rs discovery profile
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The child-observation types/methods, from_stat and their re-exports are correctly macOS-gated. The discovery-profile constants, constructor and two ledger tests are not gated and are available on Linux too. Narrow the all-new-items/macOS-only statement to the filesystem additions. The requested combined macosOnlyLinuxUnchanged value is therefore false literally; existing Linux behavior is preserved, but the portable ledger API is extended.

The unit adds public Rust platform APIs: WorkLedger::discovery_profile, ChildKind, ChildObservation and RetainedDirectory child-observation methods. Clarify or correct the false publicApiAdded/newPublicCode metadata; if those flags mean user-facing operational APIs, name that narrower meaning. No production caller, custody authority or user-facing command is added.
